evals.title: Color-only status
evals.prompt: Audit a worklist where urgent/normal/unknown are represented only by red/green/gray row backgrounds.
evals.expected_output: Textual/structural state cues added; contrast and meaning work without color.
assertions: Primary task is operable using intended keyboard/touch input.
Visible focus and semantic controls are preserved.
Important state is not color-only.
Controls have specific accessible names/labels.
Zoom/reflow does not remove identity, units or primary actions.
Essential chart/table information has an accessible equivalent.
